api.base_url: https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest (ArcGIS Online); https://<host>/portal/sharing/rest and https://<host>/server/rest/services (Enterprise); feature layer query at <service>/FeatureServer/<n>/query

scopes_needed_read: Read access to the customer's feature services / items shared with the app or its service account
auth.token_lifetime: API key: long-lived, up to one year (Esri docs via search); OAuth user tokens shorter - exact values UNVERIFIED
auth.refresh: Options per Esri: OAuth 2.0 user authentication, OAuth 2.0 app credentials (client_id/client_secret), or API key. For a customer's private content, the customer admin creates an API key credential or shares a service account / registers an OAuth app in their org.

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None needed for customer-key access; optional Esri partner network
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: In ArcGIS Online/Enterprise: register an app (OAuth client id/secret) or create an API key with item access, and share the target feature layers with it (or provide a read-only service account). Customer-hosted Enterprise servers must be reachable from us.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: $0 for a free ArcGIS Location Platform / developer account; customer ArcGIS credit consumption for hosted layers is the customer's

sandbox.how_to_get: Free ArcGIS Location Platform account (Esri lists Location Platform, ArcGIS Online and Enterprise as account types for development).

rate_limits: UNVERIFIED (varies by org plan and service; ArcGIS Online services default maxRecordCount per query page)

events: Feature service webhooks exist for hosted layers (create/update/delete) - Esri docs not fetched; UNVERIFIED

data_objects_to_pull: feature layers (assets, parcels, permits, work orders)
incremental_sync: Hosted feature layers: Esri notes editingInfo.dataLastEditDate works only for hosted feature layers, not proxied server services. Query with where on editor-tracking fields (e.g. last_edited_date) or use Change Tracking / extractChanges on layers with it enabled (extractChanges not confirmed this turn).

unified_api_coverage.nango: yes (nav list contains arcgis; exact page not fetched)

blockers: Per-customer registration; Enterprise on-prem needs network reachability
Layers without editor tracking cannot be pulled incrementally
sources: https://developers.arcgis.com/documentation/mapping-apis-and-services/security/oauth-2/ - user authentication vs app credentials authentication (via search results)
https://developers.arcgis.com/documentation/security-and-authentication/api-key-authentication/how-to-use-an-api-key/ - API key valid up to one year (via search)
https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/ - index; query page fetch 404 under one URL, parameters list seen in retrieved copy of the query page (returnIdsOnly, orderByFields, resultOffset)
community.esri.com discussion (secondary) - dataLastEditDate only on hosted feature layers
